scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof based on orbit-weight averaging and simplicial dominated vertices; finite checks corroborative only; no authorship or independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: A homotopy equivalence, not a PL homeomorphism to the smaller-cube union; \(k\ge4\), one moved coordinate cycle, Hamming scale exactly two. Ambient smaller-cube sphere counts are attributed to Adamaszek--Adams; no independent validation or comprehensive proof of novelty beyond examined sources.
title: Long coordinate cycles leave two lower-dimensional hypercube Rips complexes
